NAME: S3-Compatible Object Store
DESCRIPTION: SigV4 signer and response reader for any S3-compatible object store (Cloudflare R2, AWS S3, Backblaze B2, MinIO, Wasabi, GCS interoperability): put, get, head, delete, list and multipart as HttpRequest frames for hostcap/http-request. Holds the credential read grant and the clock, no network and no write grant.
